_comment: Kokoro pronunciation lexicon (R&D 2026-08-03, 5.1). Keys are matched as whole words, case-insensitive, in narration text; values are misaki/Kokoro phonemes (NOT standard IPA - diphthongs are A=ei, I=ai, O=ou, W=au, Y=oi; validate with scripts/check_lexicon.py before committing). Words misaki can't voice get logged to state/tts-oov.log - promote them here.
